item.title: Kenya Met Boss Reveals Cause of Unusual February Rains & End Date
item.description: The Kenya Met boss indicated that with the country now transitioning fully into the long rain season, more consistent rainfall is expected in the coming weeks.

item.title: SHA to Introduce Air Ambulance Services for Civil Servants, Police
item.description: Already, SHA has hit a wall with teachers who are demanding to leave the scheme, with concerns from other civil servants over the operations of the public scheme.

item.title: NYS Announces Mass Recruitment; Lists Requirements
item.description: NYS announced that successful applicants will enjoy a salary and allowances, medical cover under the SHA and other benefits enjoyed by civil servants.

item.title: U.S. Army Begins Joint Military Training With KDF, Other Armies
item.description: At least 1,500 personnel are undertaking the training which coincides with the ongoing hostilities in the Middle East that have the U.S. ordering evacuations from the region.

item.title: Concern for Kenyans as U.S. Orders Immediate Evacuation From Middle East
item.description: Over 400,000 Kenyans are now caught in the murky war between the U.S. and Israel on one side and Iran on the other, with the latter launching a bombing campaign in the Gulf.

item.title: Trump Sanctions Top Rwandan Military Officials Amid Kagame's Defiance
item.description: Kagame and Tshisekedi are set to meet this weekend in Arusha for the 25th Ordinary Summit of the EAC Heads of State on Saturday, which will undoubtedly be another tense gathering.

item.title: High Court Orders Govt to Pay Former MP Ksh 30M in Rights Case
item.description: The government failed to protect the former lawmaker's property in 1998 and 1999 when thousands of people invaded his sisal farm, according to the court.

item.title: Sudan Threatens to Retaliate Against Ethiopia Over Alleged Drone Attacks
item.description: Sudan and Ethiopia are at loggerheads again after the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam, brewing a fresh headache for President Ruto, who is a huge ally of PM Abiy Ahmed.

item.title: KUCCPS Opens Applications for 31 Medical Courses for C & D Students
item.description: KUCCPS encouraged students to carefully review requirements and ensure they meet the minimum qualifications before submitting their applications.

item.title: Economists Explain Why Kenyans Will Not Enjoy Cheaper Loans in Coming Months
item.description: Experts express concerns that the shilling could be impacted as well as gains made in controlling inflation, a situation that may limit CBK's ability to cut rates.
